base_properties.human_readable: The Existence of Local Optima in Non-Convex Spaces

perspectives.label: Powerless Search Algorithm
perspectives.comment: A search algorithm with limited resources is trapped within the landscape and cannot escape local optima.

perspectives.label: Mathematical Understanding
perspectives.comment: From a mathematical perspective, the existence of local optima is an inherent property of non-convex spaces.

perspectives.label: Analytical Observer
perspectives.comment: Analytical observer views this as inherent to the mathematics of non-convex spaces

commentary.narrative_context: In any non-convex optimization landscape, there exist local optima—solutions that are superior to all their immediate neighbors but are not the best possible solution (the global optimum). This is a fundamental constraint in many computational and mathematical problems.
key_agents: Powerless Search Algorithm: Primary target (powerless/trapped) - Unable to escape local optima due to limited resources.
Mathematical Understanding: Primary beneficiary (institutional/analytical) - understands the fundamental properties of non-convex spaces.
Analytical Observer: Analytical observer (analytical/analytical) - sees the full structure and its implications.
commentary.logic_rationale: Extractiveness is low because it's a mathematical property, not an actively enforced constraint. Suppression is low as well because one can, in principle, always find the global optimum given enough time or a clever algorithm. Theater ratio is low, as the phenomenon is fundamental and not performative.
commentary.perspectival_gap: All perspectives classify as mountain because the existence of local optima is a fundamental mathematical property that is not dependent on the observer.
commentary.directionality_logic: The algorithms are the victim as they are being 'extracted' from, whereas the mathematical perspective benefits from understanding the concept, therefore has 'negative' extraction.
commentary.mandatrophy_analysis: Not applicable, as extractiveness is very low.
